احتكرت (form VIII)
# اِحْتَكَرْتُ (iḥtakartu) /iħ.ta.kar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اِحْتَكَرْتَ (iḥtakarta) /iħ.ta.kar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اِحْتَكَرْتِ (iḥtakarti) /iħ.ta.kar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# اِحْتَكَرَتْ (iḥtakarat) /iħ.ta.ka.rat/: third-perso
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
